Bau layyam, ba rahav saro shel mitzrayim veshel yam amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe harem (et mattecha) vente (et) yadcha. kevan deamar harem et matecha mahu unete et yadcha, ella harem et matecha neged rahav saro shel mitzrayim. bau lemara, kama mayim marim nizdamnu etzlam venitztaar moshe vetzaak. hada hu dichtiv (Shemot 15:25) vayitzak el Adonai.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu. moshe, hare lecha etza baze. hashelech hammatte etzlam veyitchakek nachash ale tzur, shenehem beyachad, veyitzolu. hada hu dichtiv (sham) vayyorehu Adonai etz vayyashlech el hammayim. etz, kema deittemar (Kohelet 11:3) makom sheyippol haetz, shehu etza, vayyashlech el hammayim. uchetiv (Shemot 15:25) sham sam lo chok umishpat, nachash ale tzur. vesham nisahu, itrahu benisim amar hakkadosh baruch hu mikkan ulehala hare lecha sheyaamod etzel hammayim hare lecha lehitkadesh shemi bemayim.

Keshbau leelim, bau hammayim lekatreg bahem. amar hakkadosh baruch hu, bamakom hazze en tzarich mate. hare yaakov shehu ilan beshivim nefesh vehu shivim temarim ushetem esre enot mayim, shenem asar shevatim beshivim ammudim veyv shevatim. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 1:29) ki yevosho meelim asher chamadtem.

Miyyad, vayachanu sham al hammayim bammakom hazze shenikra ilan, vehu elim. mashma dichtiv al hammayim, umishma dichtiv sham sam lo velo bemakom acher vesham shaltu bene yisrael al hammayim velo hutzerach hammatte. mikkan ulehala itzterich hammatte, benachash ale tzur etzel hammayim.

Bau lechorev bau hammayim lekatreg, amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu, (Shemot 16) vehikkita batzur, hammatte itzterich hacha vehikkita laelu beoto tzur velo benachash. amar moshe yattir itzterich hacha, ana chame mayim debayyayn leshatfa. amay, (Shemot 16) hinni omed lefanecha sham al hatzur bechorev vehikkita batzur.

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe, adayin bimriva atidin hammayim lekatreg yoter, shehem mayim achurim raim uzedonim veyizdavvevgu bahem yisrael baggaluy leenehon. veota shaa itzterich hammatte vehittir alehem hannachash baggaluy leenehem, veyitkadesh shemi. hada hu dichtiv, lehakedisheni bemayim leenehem. mahu leenehem, davar shenizdavvevgu bahem baggaluy.

Ta chaze, hachi chama david. dichtiv, (Tehillim 124:2) lule Adonai shehaya lanu bekum alenu adam, ze paro. (Tehillim 124:2) azay avar al nafshenu hammayim hazzedonim kedamrinan (Tehillim 124:7) nafshenu ketzippor nimleta mippach yokshim.

Amar rabbi abba, ma raa moshe beota shaa shello asa banachash, ella yisrael hayu dochakim lomoshe, tena lanu mayim, nityyayetz veamar. kudesha berich hu amar li, amod banachash vaana chame deen gezera lenachash bemayim ella beafar. amar rabbi yehuda mehacha, (Bereshit 3:14) veafar tochal kol yeme chayyecha mashma deafar yechul kol yomoy, aval la bemayya. veyisrael dachakin li, veaf al gav deyitavid nisa, la yitavid beatar da, ella itchakak beafra vela bemayya. dichtiv (Shemot 4:3) vayashlichehu artza vayhi lenachash. vetzur beda itchakak bemayya bemara, ukkevar avad nisa behay, deitavid zimna achara. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 20:11) vayyach et hassela bemattehu paamayim. amar leh kudesha berich hu, moshe (Bamidbar 20:11) yaan lo heemantem bi lehakedisheni, dechashavtun dela yachil nachash bemayim. Ben kitfoy it leh roshem chad ved saarin beh chad minayyhu beemtztzeita rav vtale, 9 ochoranin zeirin. vead la hava avera da, havu telat zeirin. vechad deitrasham beh dakik uzeer mikkullehu. hahu roshem hava beh mikkadmat dena ucham, vinun saarin chivvarin kullehu, hasheta lav hachi. ella roshem ukkam vechad sumaka utelofcha birshimu beemtztzaita, vhahu saara deitrabbe ben ochoranin. resheh sumak vshara chivvar. i tav betiuveta, tishkach beeneha yemina chad chivvra, chivvar go hahu ukkama.

1606: Zeer, utelat sharin beemtztzaita kullehu kachada zeira. yechkam beorayyta (i) yolif, vela yitztzelach beovadoy.
Vi yeroka deena la yitztzetabba kol kach, veenoy ukkamin vechad chuta vesumak zeer ibar ben inun goonin, keden ihu beat 80 bishlimu, uveot Rabbi bilchodoy.

Bemitztzecheh tishkach shit sirtutin. telat avrin, utelat la avrin, saareh takif vela kol kach, tale vela tale, hay ihu bishlimu lechol bar nash, kamtztzan ihu. let beh chidu, vaafillu bechedva la chaze bedavuna chaze.
Atim udeneh semaleh. beshinoy it telat ravrevin milella. veyahavin lon ducheta inun diltatta. mehemana ihu vela (15 daf 26 74) kol kach,

Anpoy arichin vela shappirin. kaleh keitteta, umiloy keitteta, mekaneach pumeh bemilloy, aftach etztzebaan didoy bemilluleh. kad azil, akdim leh belitta defarsay, dela yichuv bar nash legabbeh. aleh ketiv (Devarim 24:4) ki toeva hi lifne Adonai.

Ayynin yerokin veillen simanin beh, vanpoy arichin shappiran. saroy uchemin umeritin milella boresha, resheh rav. kad azil, kafif resheh. keritztzin deenoy bekadmoa alayyhu ketiv (Mishlei 1:15) mena raglecha mintoyvata.

Ayynin ravrevin viyrokin da ihu bitren atvavn, Rabbi 81. chad yechida vechad bishlimu. bemitztzecheh sirtuta deazil vaavar mistar listar, utelat ochoranin it dela avrin. mitztzeche rav. keritztzin deal enoy, la ravrevin. bedikeneh saara tappe. da beanpoy shappiru sumak. saareh sheia vela kol kach,

Dachil chataa ihu, rachim orayyta ihu. rachim leinun demishtadlin bah. chade becholla, avid tivu lechola, kediva letoalteh. mehemana ihu lerazin deorayyta. tav ihu lemilin dealma. man deishtataf bahadeh la atztzelach, la ihu vela achara. atztzelach ihu bilchodoy deha at Rabbi garim.

Pagim ihu beresheh. leella rishuma dechad machtesha dehava leh tamman, deavad leh chad ravya beavna bela reu vchauvna, veichse besara. vehahu rishuma demachtesha kegavvna degimel yevanit. mehemana ihu legabbeh bene nasha, salik lemehevi resha deammeh, ad hacha razin deayynin.
Veit razin ochoranin deayynin demitparshin minayyhu. ayynin demeamkan vechayyeychan, da ihu bishlimu deatvavn bar dekadmaa. Rabbi uvatar 80 da ihu bar nash deatztzelach beovadoy

3 Sirtutin bemitztzecheh, mitztzeche agil. enoy nehirin merakman ovad tziyyur (dachyayn) kayymin al shelimu. sanoy yippelu techoteh. pekicha ihu, atztzelach vecholla, bahil beovadoy. tav ihu im bene nasha, milloy bekashyu uvela dechilu. vtran ihu avid tivu vela lishmah.

Vetalya saareh sheia velishne kecharba. techot enoy kemitin telat ravrevan utelat zeirin, vi it 4 utelat ravrevan. keden tashkach teren (15 daf 27 amud alef) sirtutin bemitztzecheh avrin mistar listar 9 dematu vla matu.

Techot tibbure kayayma reshima chad tziyyura deresha debar nash ukkam vechivvavr. teren saarin talyayn beh, hahu bar nash itkashal beittat gevar miyyomin rechokin vela tav mehahu chova. marin radfin abbatreh, veal da inun marin, chad detztzaik leoshada shetten vela yachil, dead kean hahu chova talyyay bekadle. denachash akima vshalit aleh beda, veda lesof yomin desivu.

Vi tav betiuveta bezimna deihu becheleh, hahu reshima azirat diyyukena vesaarin la talyayn beh kelal. vei tav betiuveta besof yomoy kad marin radfin avatreh, keden hahu reshima kamit, vesaaran talyayn beh, vhahu mara la adiu minnih, miggo detalyay bekadle denachash,

Begin dehahu nachash, kevan deachit hahu chova al kadle, let man deyatir kishra mikadle. begin dehahu nachash let leh reshu vime deulemoy debar nash lokishra hahu chova al kadle. vekashrin leh bekishrin takkifin

Vihu radif abbatreh dehahu bar nash, umalke leh behahu berit dechav beh. vaf al gav detav betiuveta, yitztzevvavch miggo aku demalkiutta. hahu chivya dalig veal behahu kishra, veshippule dithoma rabba. keden ravavch leh lebar nash. vehahu nachash levar (levatar) yomin nafik veavid da.
Uvezimna demit hahu bar nash, telat mea shotre radfin abbatreh dehahu bar nash vetafsin leh, veaylin leh kame malka. umalka kaddisha mittabbar inun kishrin, vnachit hahu chova meal kadle.

Veal raza da ketiv (Yeshayahu 22:14) im ychuppar haavon hazze lachem ad temutun. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 28:18) vechuppar beritchem et mavit, tavar hahu kayayma dilchon, et mavit. kema deat amer (Bereshit 32:21) achappera panav. avatel ragzeh, keden hahu bar nash, azil lehahu alma naki mehahu chova, deha kabbil onsheh behay alma.

Vchi tema hechi mashma dibbehay avon eshet ish mishtae kera, dichtiv hacha im yichuppar haavon hazze, uchetiv hatam beisur eshet ish shezinta, venikka haish meavon. uchetiv gabbe avner (Shmuel 2 3:8) vetafked alay avon haisha hayyom. i name, (Yeshayahu 22:13) vehinne sason vesimcha harog bakar ushechot tzon echol ushete. uchetiv hatam
1607: (15 Daf 56 amud bet) (Mishlei 30:20) achla umachata piha. uchetiv (Bereshit 39:6) ki im hallechem asher hu ochel.

Vi ishtechach beh zechut avot, onsheh behay alma behahu avon. kema deat amer (Tehillim 89) ufakadti beshevet pisham uvingaim avonam. ufakadti zeer zeer, (Iyov 30) im befidu lahem shua (sefer acher im yechapper lahem shogeg) (Shemot 34:7) poked avon avot al banim. zeer. venoten zeer al da uzeer al da. veishteziv hu veavoy meonasha dehahu alma. deha bera mezakke abba.

Man devae leistamra minneh, lichtov yod bideh yemina uvideh semola 77 veliftach kameh vlemar yod beippecha atvoy veyishteziv minayyhu.

Da ihu pagim leshimusha dikdusha, begine kach la sharyayn beh atvn, veha istalaku minneh. da ihu beraza dehahu kav yarok denafik mitohu bemedidu debutztzina. veit leistakkela go sirtutin deyada biymina uvismola. ubberaza deinun sirtutin deyyadin, tishkach da.
Man deena chad atim vela kol kach, vena achara pekicha. muma chad meinun mumin it beh. da ihu beot Rabbi bilchodoy beashlemutteh vat yod mate legabbeh vela mate.

Bemitztzecheh 3 sirtutin avrin vechad zeira deaavar. uf hachi reshima chada salik meeneh lekovel udeneh. saareh tale vetakkif keritztzoy ravrevin, it muma misitra achara. ima dila azlat becharshin kad hava bimaha venafkat lepitche devrchin belelya. kad da ityelid, bego teren shenin dileh itchalash, ad deazar diyyukeneh. veimmeh azlat belelya bahadeh, vka avadat charshin aleh.

Hay chadde bechedva. let beh mehemnuta, (15 daf 56 al gabbe) meshabbach garmeh bema delet beh. gas ruach, mallel bishin veatikin. vatran ihu let beh kamtztzanu kelal. mare degiufa, atztzelach vela atztzelach. chadida belishaneh.

Vi chad sirtuta bemitztzecheh rav uteren zeirin, da azal go charshin, vha immeh avadat lehu. umitchalfin sirtutin deka salkin mayena yemina leena semola. gas ruach ihu, aval let beh bisha kelal, kamtztzan ihu let beh ketztzat giufa. chadida belishaneh ihu,

Besafa dileh it beh roshem chad sumak tappe. vchad saara beemtztzaita etztzebaan di beragleh semola, kemitin zakifin mitpashshetin. ayynin zebalganin yirokin, nachtin dimin tadir. hay itdabbak beat 80, veat Rabbi la ityyayshvat beh. i it leh arba sirtutin bemitztzecheh vavrin kullehu uteren zeirin. meeneh vad saareh. teren reshimin, utelat zeirin ben keritztze enoy.

Hay ihu bar nash deazil kafif resha, zina chad mittelat mare reshimin detoladat tzaraat it beh bezineh. hay lav mesaava hu lemasgar. chadde ihu becholla vechayich tadir, kol milloy chayychin behu bene nasha. kamtztzan ihu beveteh, beochoranin lav hachi. let leh chissufa bemilloy begin dechame decholla chayychin behu. gayyfa ihu. saroy summakin zeer vela sheiin vela kemitin,

Veit bemitztzecheh telat sirtutin deavrin 9 zeirin dela avrin vechol shear simanin beh. hay (15 davar acher nusach acher it leh) let leh pegimu vroshem chad beena. debar nash dehaya tzad tzipparin deavad beh bela kavvana beaa dehava vshid letztzipparin, veihu itreshim al eneh semola, leela mikartztzoy beorka,

Hahu dehava tzad tzipparin, agzim leh behahu aa, begin dehava afrach tzipparin umecha leh bela kavvana. hay atztzelach limzone ulebeteh, vela lemichnash mamona saggi. mehemana ihu vela kol kach, vehay mehemnuta bemillin zeirin, aval beravrevin lav ihu mehemana. mare delishna bisha vechola chayyaychin bemileh.
Pumeh rav sifvvavteh ravrevin, man deishtataf bahadeh, atztzelach becholla, vihu atztzelach. uf hachi tav ihu lechol shittufa.
Reshima dehahu machtesha ayynin immeh, zebalganin yerokin vechad reshimu ukkam sachara lon hay (15 daf 97 74) ihu beat 81, bishlimu ditren atvavn, veat Rabbi bilchodoy.

Da resheh rav ved sirtutin ravrevin bemitztzecheh veg zeirin ben keritztzoy. (vechad leella kareyaa zeer). al chotme shaarin ravrevin, anpoy ravrevin, resheh agil. vechad leella keria zeer hu gibbar chela mare zedona bemillin.
Saareh kamit, gayyfa ihu, uvelelya ishtetaf ihu legayyfa. lezimnin itkeshal
1608: Ihu beintu asura. dikneh malyay besaarin. hay it leh bidroa semola chad reshimu decharba demacha leh chad gevar atim yemineh, beyoma reviaa deshabbatta, kad baa shimsha leitkansha. deha behahu zimna itar aleh chad chuta demaadim, hahu chuta debistar semola. vhahu reshima amika (17 davar acher ita akimu) bevisra beiggula,

Kad mata leyomin desivu nafal meatar derachiv beh, o suseya o chamra, o nafil mikkotla uminneh yitchalash veyamut. deha chova dechama beulemoy behevel radif abbatreh. vi hahu gavra tav betiuveta, nafil beemtztza yomoy miggo chulesha debeh, veyamut.

Vi tav veyvme ulemoy, keden tishkach sirtutin demitztzecheh, 3 ravrevin ved zeirin uteren teren miggo enoy desalkin leela. hay beorach ara yehe mare veyippol mearseh veyamut. deha lealmin nefila it beh lebasof.

Ayynin zeer dekikin, dela itchazyayn gavnin dilhon lefum shata. vechad mistakkelan behon inun yerokin veukkamin, hay ihu sifvvn chadin vappin arichin bechadidu. keden tashkach bemitztzecheh 2 sirtutin vechad zeira benayyhu hay ihu beat 80 bilchodoy uveat Rabbi bishlimu.

Hay ihu saareh talyyay vela sheia. atztzelach beovde yedoy, uveorayyta i ishtaddal uf hachi. zeira ihu beshayyfe vegam bisra let beh. gasut rucha. memallel bego chotamoy, begin denukevin dilhon dechikin, uvegin kach nafik rucha bidchiku listar semala.

Beyarcha dileh leella mearkuva, reshima chad demareh chabbura deavad leh chad ravya besakkin veyome ulemoy veistakkan beh. mekane hu leitteteh ad divne nasha chayyeychin minnih, bae leittakna beguverin ochoranin vela ittakkan vechayyeychin beh. hay la yishtattaf bar nash bahadeh (15 daf 98 81) dela yitztzelach. chamdan ihu, ishtaddal bema dela it leh. chashiv garmeh deihu gavra rabba, velav hachi. zache lebanot velo levanim.
Vi mitchalfan sirtutin teren zeirin vechad ravreva bemitztzecheh veanpoy summakin, zache livnin velivrata chada, o dilidat (bar) vistalkat mealma.

Kad at chad it leh batar udeneh yemina, roshem ditlofcha. vechad saara detalyay veresh udeneh veetztzeba zeira bida semola kafif, keden titkayyaym vetolid benin uvenan, i simanin illen yehon lah ben raglaha, yichra veyippol chad bera ben inun, diyhe mabbua dinvia bevrayyta. hu makriv umefazer mabbuin venachalin deorayyta uvishnin zeirin yitkenish mealma.

Hay ihu meinun elef demitkanshin mealma meresh shatta vead resh shatta beyomin kadmain. miditcharav makdesha la ashkach bar shittin chaser chad veillen inun demistalke mealma kad yahave recha, ad la mata zimnayyhu.

Begin dechad kudesha berich hu al veolif orayyta leinun yenokin deistalku mealma kad yahavu recha, inun kadmae beinun millin mehay alma ad la mata zimnayyhu. vekudesha berich hu amar leh hahu memanna yvpyl shemeh dekaim vekashir kishrin deorayyta. man hu den deakdim li. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 41:3) mi hikdimani vaashalem. vaashalem vday.

Keden kara kudesha berich hu lemttrvn deihu kaim go parochta deparsa veshittin elef ribbo mare deulefana deorayyta sacharaneh veihu mekasher kishrin lemareh. amar leh, man hay deakdim li, mi hikdimani vashalem. ihu rashim go metivtach o lo. amar leh, mareh dealma, lav ihu vimtivta dili, go metivtach ihu. vechol inun dekodame techot kol shemaya dileh (nusach acher dili) hu. hada hu dichtiv (Iyov 41:3) tachat kol hashshamayim li hu.
Begin ditren metivtin it leella. metivta dehahu naar metatron, umetivta ilaa dekudesha berich hu. uvechol atar detanenan metivta ilaa, da dekudesha berich hu. metivta dirkia, da demttrvn.

Keden amar leh kudesha berich hu, i hachi, lakit leh gabbay. lakit leh vaarach leh. hada hu dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 6:2) dodi yarad leganno laarugot habbosem. dodi, da kudesha berich hu, kema deat amer, (Shir HaShirim 2:16) dodi li vaani lo haroe bashshoshannim. yarad leganno, da goren dirkia, dekayyme kegoren. laarugot habboshem, da metivta demototoro 50. lirot baggannim velilkot shoshannim, leayyna uleistakkela beinun metivtan (15 daf 58 amud bet) dileh. may velilkot shoshannim, al tikre shoshannim, ella sheshshonim. illen inun dekodame rucha behay alma dematkele (17 davar acher ita dametalekat) umistalleke mehay alma ad la mata zimnayyhu.

Keden kare hahu naar metatron legavriel di keset hasofer bechartztzoy veamar leh, ketov pitka vehav lemalach hammavet al peloni deyilkot leh mealma veitlakit miyyad, vesalkin leh limtivta 318 bekadmita. vetamman amar talmudeh deayyte biyydeh, veolif tamman ma deolif. levatar salkin leh limtivta ilaa dekudesha berich hu. vezamina limtivta dileh, vetamman ishtaashaa behu beinun dileh berazi illain vetaame orayyta dahavu setimin behay alma.

1609: Ilaa, metartztzin vimtivta ilaa. delet tamman pirche vekusheyyayn ella vimtivta dirkia, vechatim mitre metivte millin deorayyta kedka yeot. veal da ketiv (tehillim 84) yilechu mechayil el chayil.

Ella hay kera hachi hu, (Tehillim 99:6) moshe veaharon bechohanav. moshe ihu nevia mehemana ilaa al kol shear neviayyay, aharon bechahane, veihu kahana ilaa al kol shear kahane alma. dela hava kahana rabba desalik bedarga ilaa keaharon. zacha aharon likkehuna unevua, navi vechohen, ma dela zacha kahana achara. vei tema ha zecharya kohen venavi hava, hahi nevua leshaata havavt vechulei.
1618: Rabbi yehuda verabbi yitzchak havu azle bearcha, ad dahavu azle pagu behahu yenoka dehava azil vehava lae. amar lon, laina dela achilna yoma den. afiku nahama veyahavu leh, itrachish lon nisa veashkachu chad neviu dakik demayya (sefer acher techot ilana) techothon veshatu minneh veyatvu.

Patach hahu yenoka veamar, (Vayikra 1:1) vyyikra el moshe, hacha alef zeira, amay. begin dehay keria la hava bishlimu, may tama dela hava ella bemashkena uveara achara. begin dishlimu la ishtekach ella beara kaddisha.

Tu, hacha shechinta, hatam shelimu dedchar vnukeba (divrei hayamim 1 1:1) adam shet enosh, adam shelimu didchar venukeba, hacha nukeba. tu sefa dikra vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor, begin kach 1 zeira.

Vetu 1 zeira metal lemalka dehava yativ bechuresayyay vekitra demalchuta aleh veikre melech ilaa, kad nachit veazil lebe avdeh, melech zuta ikre. kach kudesha berich hu, kol zimna deihu leella al kolla, melech ilaa ikre. kevan denachit medoreh letatta, melech ihu, aval lav ilaa kedkadmita. begin kach alef zeira.

Vyyikra, hachi tanenan, zamin leh lehechaleh meohel moed. man hu ohel moed, ohel debeh talenan moada vechaga veshabbeta lemimne. kema deat amer (Bereshit 1:14) vehayu leotot ulemoadim uveh sharyay chushebana lemimne, uman ihu sihara. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 33:20) ohel bal yitzan bal yisa yetdotav lanetzach.

Lemor, may lemor, begin legallaa. aval kola chad veshappir hu, begin dishlimu hu atar legallaa ma dehava satim lego. uvechol atar, lemor, kema deat amer, vydabber Adonai el moshe lemor, vaydabber Adonai elav meohel moed lemor. deityeyhiv reshu legallaa, deha itmane lesihara hahu milla meatar demoshe kayayma. vydabber Adonai leella. el moshe beemtzaita. lemor babberayyta (sefer acher babetareyya) atar deit reshu legallaa.

Tu vayyikra el moshe, ma ketiv leella (Shemot 39) vayaviu et hammishkan el moshe vegomer. ammay el moshe, hachi amru, begin demoshe chama leh betura vekudesha berich hu achme leh bechezu deena kema deat amer (Shemot 27:8) kaasher hera otcha bahar. (Bamidbar 8:4) kammare asher hera Adonai et moshe vegomer. uchetiv (Shemot 25:40) uree vaase betavnitam asher atta more bahar. hasheta deaytiu leh, begin deyichme i ihu kehahu mashkena dechama (sefer acher begin daychamey ihu hahu mashkena dechama).

Aval amay vayaviu et hammishkan el moshe. ella lemalka devaa lemivne palterin lematronita, pakid leumanin, hechala da, beduch pelan. vehechala da beduch pelan. hacha atar learse. hacha atar lenayycha. kevan deavidu lon umanin achamiu lemalka. kach, vyaviu et hammishkan el moshe marih deveta, ish haelohim. kevan deishtachlal hechala lematronita, zeminat lemalka lemechala. zeminat levala immah, begin kach vyyikkera el moshe.
Uvegin demoshe mare deveta ihu, ma ketiv (Shemot 33:7) vemoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane. moshe deihu mareh deveta avad hachi (45) delet reshu lebar nash achara lemebad hachi.

Vydabber Adonai elav darga achara ilaa, ucheden beshaata deizdaman moshe lemeal keden patach veamar adam ki yakriv mikkem. may adam hacha, ella kad itchabberan shimsha vsihara kachada. patach veamar adam, kedichtiv (Chavakuk 3:11) shemesh yareach amad zevula. amad velo amdu.

Ki yakriv mikkem, hacha itremiz man deyaavid pulechana dekarbena shelim deyishtechach dechar vnukeba, mashma mikkem deyishtechach kechizu dilchon. karban laAdonai, deyakriv kolla leitachada kachada ela vtatta.

Min habbehema, leachazaa adam uvehema vecholla kachada. min habbakar umin hatztzon, illen retichin deinun dachyayn. kevan deamar min habbehema, yachol mikkolla ben dachyayn ben mesaavan, hadar veamar min habbakar umin hatztzon vegomer.

Karbanchem, karbani mibbae leh. may karebbanchem ella bekadmita karban laAdonai, hasheta karbanchem karban laAdonai adam karbanchem min habbakar umin hatztzon leachazaa yichuda meella letatta. umittatta
1619: Leella hayeynu karban laAdonai, meella letatta hayeynu karbanchem.

Metal lemalka deihu yativ betureseka ilaa leella vecharsayyay dileh ittakkan al hahu tureseka umalka ilaa al kolla. bar nash dekariv karbena (sefer acher dorona) lemalka, baa lesalka midarga ledarga ad desalik mittatta leella leatar demalka yativ, ilaa al kol kolla. ucheden yadin deha salkin dorona lemalka vhahu dorona (sefer acher demalka) min malka ihu. nachit dorona meella letatta, ha yedian dehahu dorona (sefer acher demalka) nachit meella lirchima demalka deihu letatta.

Kach bekadmita adam salik bedargoy mittatta leella, ucheden karban laAdonai min habbehema min habbakar, nachit bedargoy meela letatta ucheden karebbanchem. begin kach (Shir HaShirim Adonai:1) achalti yari im divshi vegomer hayeynu adam karban laAdonai. ichlu reim hayeynu min habbehema min habbakar umin hatztzon. ucheden takrivu et karbanchem.

Atu ribbi yehuda ver yitzchak uneshakuhu. amru berich rachamana, dezachena lemishma da. amar rabbi yehuda yeot hava lehahu yenoka dela yinda kule hay, vana mistappena aleh i yitkayyaym bealma begine hay, amar rabbi yitzchak velamma. amar leh, deha yachil leistakkela beatar delet reshu lebar nash leistakkela beh umistafena alloy dead la yimte lefirkoy yistakkal veyishgach veyeanshun leh,

Shama hahu yenoka. amar, la mistappena meonasha lealmin deha beshaata deistallak abba mealma, barich li vetzalli alay veyaddana dizchuta deabba yagin alay. amar leh man hu avuch. amar bereh derav hamenuna sava. natlu leh vearkevu leh al kitfayyhu telat milin. azlu vsaddaru milin kameh derabbi shimon. amar lon, vadday yeruta orayyta achsin, veilmale zechuta deavoy itanash milleella, aval kudesha berich hu, leinun deazilu batra deorayyta achsinu lah inun uvanayyhu lealmin.

Shamor et yom hashabbat, hahu bemidda sheviit neemar dichtiv, et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau, may nihu midda sheviit hevi omer ze middat tuvo shel hakkadosh baruch hu. umay tama amar shabbetotay velo amar shabbetay. mashal lema haddavar dome, lemelech shehaya lo ishsha naa, vechol shavua veshavua mazmina yom echad lihyot immo. vehammelech yesh lo banim naim veohavam, veamar lahem hoil vechen hu, simchu gam attem beyom simchati, ki ani beshelachem ani mishtaddel, vegam attem hadru oti. umay tama zachor veshamor. zachor lazzachar veshamor lachalla. umay tama umikdashi tirau, shimru atzmechem min hahirhur, ki mikdashi kadosh hu. lama, ki ani Adonai bechol tzad.

Amar rabbi rechumay mahu dichtiv vayisa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem vayyered, veha kevar yarad. ella vayyered measot hachattat vehaola veachar kach vayisa aharon et yadav el haam. nesiut zo lamma, lefi shehikriv karban venitratza lifne avihem sebbashamayim. kedamar tzarich oto shemkarvan laelyonim umeyaychadan leyayched bichlalan ellu. uma el haam, baavur haam. umay tama binsiut levarech lehon bivracha, ella mishum deyesh baadam eser etzbaot remez ley sefirot shenechtemu behon shamayim vaaretz.

Patach rabbi nehoray befarashat tzitzit vedarash, (Bamidbar 15:38) veasu lahem tzitzit al kanfe vigdehem ledorotam. may shena dehacha uveshabbat ledorotam chaser, dichtiv, (Shemot 31:16) laasot et hashshabbat ledorotam, chaser. detaninan. tiknu parashat tzitzit bikriat shema. uvedirato shel adam, nimtza parashat keriat shema, chutz mipparashat tzitzit, shechaser mishsham. bamme nishlam. ella kesheadam mitattef beveto batztzitzit, veyotze vo lefitcho, hare nishlam. vehakkadosh baruch hu sameach bo, umalach hammavt zaz mishsham vehayeynu ledorotam, sheyyihye shalem. veyetze mippetach beto bemitzva zo, umalach hammashchit zaz mishsham vnitzol haadam mikkol nezek. menalan. mimmay dichtiv mezuzot, meotiyyotav mashma, zaz mavt. shello nittan lo reshut lechabbel, vezaz mippitcho.
Beshabbat dichtiv ledorotam, may tama. mippene shekkevan shekkiddash hayyom, diratam shel yisrael tzericha lihyot
1620: Bener daluk, veshulchan aruch, umitta memutztzaat vediratan metukkenet kedirat chatan lekabbel bo hakkalla. umay nihu. shabbat hi kalla. uleolam en machnisin otah ella bedira metukkenet lichvodah, kefi harauy lah. veal da ketiv, laasot et hashshabbat. uchetiv, ledorotam, lehachenis bah kalla kedosha lediratah velihyot betochah. beshaa shekkiddash hayyom, vechalla zo baa, venah motza dira metukkenet, veshulechan aruch, vner daluk. kalla zo omeret, en dira zo miyyisrael. beni uven bene yisrael ketiv, en ze miyyisrael, en dirato likdushsha. al ken tzarich hekker kedushsha babbayit. veal da ketiv ledorotam, beshabbat uvetzitzit.

Amar ribbi nehoray, ashaddena, al man denafak mittera beteh beittufa demitzva, utefillin berosho, beshaa denafek ben teren tarin, izdammena shechina aleh. uteren malachin dekayymin aleh, chad miyyamina, vechad missemala, vechullehon melavvin leh ad be kenishta, umevarchin leh. vechad mekatrega deihu kayyma kamme pitche devar nash azel mibbatrayyhu, veal karcheh atev vaamar amen.

Sefer habbahir may tama anu metilin techelet batztzitzit, umay tama sheloshim ushetayim. mashal lema haddavar dome lemelech shehaya lo gan nae velo sheloshim ushetayim netivot vesam shomer alehen, vehodio levaddo otan hanetivot. amar lo, shomrem velech bahem bechol yom vechol zeman shetadrichem shalom lach.

Ma asa hashomer, amar, im ani ehye levaddi beelle hanetivot, i efshar leshomer echad lekayyem ellu hanetivot. veod ki yomru haolam, kilay hu melech ze veshomer ze. lechach sam shomer ze, shomrim acherim al hanetivot ele shehen sheloshim ushetayim netivot.

Umay tama detchelet amar hashomer shemma yomru hashomrim, haggan sheli hu. natan lahem siman, reu hasiman lammelech shehu shello, shehaggan hazze veelle hanetivot hu tiknam, venam sheli vehinne chotamo.

Mashal lema haddavar dome lemelech ubbito shehayu lahem avadim, bikshu lelech merachok, pachadu min emat hammelech. natan lahem hammelech simano. pachadu min habbat vnattena lahem siman. amru, meatta bishne simanin ellu (Tehillim 121:7) Adonai yishmarcha mikkol ra, yishmor et nafshecha.

(Od sham) umay nihi, eretz denechtzava mimmenna shamayim vehi kiso shel hakkadosh baruch hu. vehi even yekara, vehi yam hachachma. uchenegda techelet betalit tzitzit. deamar rabbi meir, ma nishtana (deamar) techelet mikkol mine tzivonin, mippene shettechelet dome layyam. vehayyam dome larakia veharakia dome lekise hakkavod. shenneemar (Shemot 24:10) vyyiru et elohe yisrael vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar uchetiv kemare even sappir demut kisse. (ad kan):

Dichtiv totze haaretz nefesh chayya, dehahu chayya ilaa. uvegin dehay nefesh chayya ihi kaddisha ilaa, kad ara kaddisha mashcha lah begavav vitkelilat bah, keden karenan lah neshama. veta chaze, bechol zimna debar nash azil beorach keshot, ufume velishane memallan milin kaddishin bitzlota, beorayyta. hay nishmata itdabbekat beh, rechima hu demareh. kama neturin natrin leh mikkol sitrin. reshima hu letav leella vetatta ushechinta kaddisha sharyay aloy. veda hi desalka leella umemalla kame
1621: Malka kaddisha veayyla bechol tarin velet deyimche bidaha. veal da ittekre ruach memalla. deha kol shear nafshata (napeshatean) let lon reshu lemallela kame malka bar hay.

Uvezimna deihu aste orchoy vesifvvavteh velishane memallan milin bishin, shechinta istalkat minneh venishmata kaddisha itabberat minneh vela itdabbekat beh. umisitra dechivyay bisha takkifa itar rucha chada deshat veachil bealma, dela sharyay ella beatar dikdusha ilaa istelak mittamman.

Vinun milin salkin leatar dechivyay bisha, decholla leatreh ithadar. uveshaata desalkin, kolla machrizin veamrin istalaku sucheraneh demila bisha diflanya. penun atar learcheh dechivyay takkifa. vehahi neshama salka bechissufa, beaku decholla. vela yahavin lah atar lemallela kemilkadmin. ucheden chivyyay izdaman.

Vechad hahi milla bisha salka beorchin yedian veshare kame dechivyay takkifa kama ruchin mitarin bealma verucha nachta mehahu sitra, veashkach dehahu bar nash itar leh bemilla bisha. veha rucha memalla kaddisha itabberat minneh, keden sharyay aloy vesaiv leh, ucheden hu sagir vitpegim bivsareh bechizu deanpoy becholla.

Veal da ketiv (Mishlei 21:23) shomer piv uleshono shomer mitzarot nafsho. nafsho vadday, hahi dehava memalla itavidat mashtuka begin milula bisha uchemma deonsha debar nash behay, begin milla bisha, kach onsheh begin milla tava (deate lideh deyachil lemallala velo mallil):

Vechi bechol et yachil bar nash lemebad tzedaka, i hachi teresar shate beyoma man yachil. ella hachi olifna, man deavid tzedaka bechol et. may bechol et, kema deat amer (Vayikra 16:2) veal yavo bechol et el hakkodesh, vukemuha.

Vela tema bichneset yisrael bilchodoy, deihi et raava kaddisha betzadik. ella afillu bechol et diltatta asge tzedaka alayyhu vitar tzedaka bechullehu, beillae vetattae. begin kach yeshavvi libbeh ureuteh bar nash veyidbak beh bekudesha berich hu.

Kevan dematu kame derabbi shimon sachu leh ovada. amar, uma da bilchodoy, afillu kol man deachid leilana (beilana) dechaye ishteziv behay alma vafillu min mota dealma, mishar bene nasha. kol shekken meachara.

Amar rabbi shimon bechullehu itar tzedaka ilana dechaye, vehay atar ihu dimzona lechola letalmide chachamim. may avidtayyhu deha kol bene alma la yachle leitara tzedaka alayyhu, deha inun bitzdaka achidan vechol bene alma bizchutayyhu nizonin, behu mammash. vinun la yachlin leitzana behu mammash, begin dechol man deishatadal beorayyta, ishtaddal beilana dechaye dechol bene alma nizonin minneh. ishtekach detalmide chachamim mitare mezona lealma ushelama.

I lechol bene alma mitare mezona, lon amay la mitare. ella talmid chacham hu ilana dechaye mammash. veilana dechaye la mittezan ella min haolam habba. vehaolam habba la ishtekach behay alma ella levatar deal lehahu alma, keden ittezan beh veitnetau sharshoy aleh.
Hasheta achle meibba deilana dechaye. uman ihu, hahu atar deishtakkach legabbe miskena veihu ikre (Bereshit 3:3) peri haetz asher betoch haggan. veal da achle mehahu peri behay alma.

Veal da tanenan, hem nizonin bizroa. may bizroa, da gevura. veinun zeminin leolam habba. dimzona deolam habba, lav ihi behay alma, ella tzimtzuma zeira dechela dileh, deishtakkach bimtiku deorayyta. veda taame al hahu ibba deilana tattaa veda chedu detalmide chachamim umezona ilaa dilhon.

Kevan deyaavrun mehay alma, kama nechalin illain deolam habba sacharan leduchetayyhu, veyishtarshun beh veyistalkun leella leella. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin lo raata elohim zulatecha yaase limchakke lo. may yaase, da yovla. hahu deikkere haolam habba. limchakke lo vday, dela bayayn mezona lealma da, ad deatan (sefer acher daataken) limzona dilhon. umay mezona dilhon, haolam habba. veal da zakkaan becholla. dealayyhu ketiv ayin lo raata elohim vegomer:

Shiva yomin illain, bara kudesha berich hu bealma. vaalayyhu shatel uvane almin. hada hu dichtiv (Shemot 20:11) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai, velo chetiv besheshet. velokovel inun shiva yomin illain, bara beara shiva zakkae keshot, lekayyma lon, uleanhara lon, kol chad vechad lokovel yomeh. veshatel leho, kol chad vechad bedara deitchaze leh. vinun avahan dealma, avraham yitzchak vyaakov veyosef umoshe veaharon
1622: Vedavid.

Veinun ikrun harim, harere kedem, deinun talyayin meinun shiva yomin illain daamaran. 6 yome bereshit, vez dekayyma kammayyhu, hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 12:8) uvet david kelohim kemalach Adonai lifnehem. veaf al gav deihu sheviaa, reviaa ihu beyomin. veyosef ihu sheviaa. aval kad itkelilat beh beyosef, veyahev leh tosefet tafnuka mibbe malka, ikre uf ihi sheviaa.

Vechalho achidu ba bishchinta, beraza deshiva. begin dishchinta ikre bat sheva. bat meimma illaa, deihi kelala desheva dargin deimma. veihi darga detzedek, asiraa deinun sefirin, deikre behu kudesha berich hu.

Veikre sheviaa bikra, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) dilcha Adonai haggedulla vehaggevura vehattiferet vehannetzach vehahod ki chol vechulei, ad hammamlacha. umay tama, veha reviaa hi leyome. ella begin deihi netia batraa, vitkelilat bishviaa, begin kach natla shemeh, vecholla chad.

Vechol chad vechad meavahan, yada leh lekudesha berich hu, miggo aspaklarya dileh. avraham yada leh, miggo chesed, deihu middat haggedulla, middat hachesed, yamina demalka. veal da achid bah, vela shavik lah lealmin, veavid tivu im bene nasha, vokmuha. deha ovadoy seliku leh behay darga.

Yitzchak yada leh bedarga digvura, deikre pachad yitzchak, vedachil leh lealmin. yaakov yada leh miggo darga detiferet. deihu kalil mechesed umippachad, veikre emet, vachid ba. hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov.
Yosef yada leh lekudesha berich hu miggo hahi aspaklarya, deikre chol. veal da ikre yosef kilkel, dichtiv (Bereshit 47:12) vychalkel yosef. vikre yesod olam.

Moshe veaharon inun teren keruvin, deishtema kala dilela mibbenayyhu, veal da ityeyhivat orayyta al yadayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, venoadti lecha sham vedibbarti ittecha vegomer. veinun teren keruvin dilela, inun netzach vahod, veinun teren samchin degufa.

Kegavvna da, it lah lematronita letatta, teren keruvin techotah, deyankin minah. veinun illain vday, al aron haedut, deikre tzedek, arona deedut. uman edut, da yosef, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 81:6) edut bihosef samo. veikre tora shebbichtav, vehay arona tora shebbeal pe.

Ta chaze, kol inun avahan illain daachidan leela, remizan kalho battora shebbichtav, torat Adonai. vedavid deihu achid bevaryayta, deihi tora shebbeal pe, remiza bedivre kabbala. uvegin kach ikre kabbala, dimkabbelet nehiru mittora shebbichtav, deikre tzaddik, veikre yosef, vikre chol.

Veinun teren keruvin illain, kayymin al hahu sahaduta daarona, hada hu dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 1 29:11) vehannetzach vehahod, ki chol bashshamayim uvaaretz, veda ihu siyyuma dishmaya umezavvivg lehay eretz.
Vehache hu, dechol ma shebbara kudesha berich hu leela, bara lekivleh letatta. veyosef ikre edut, hada hu dichtiv edut bihosef samo. veal da shema deyosef shelim becholla leela vetatta.

Veal da taninan, aron deyosef varon dishchinta, bahade hadade havo azlin bemadbera, vahavu kulle alma amre ma tivan shel shene aronot ellu. umetivin lon, kiyyem ze ma shekkatuv baze. kiyyem vday, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:25) vetzaddik yesod olam, ihu kiyyuma dealma.

Ata david deihu sheviaa, daavahan achid ba, behay bat sheva, deihi mamlacha, vela shavik lah lealmin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 37:25-26) vedavid avdi nasi lahem leolam. uchetiv, (Tehillim 89:37) kiso kashshemesh negdi. vechol da olif lan orayyta, dechalho achidan ba bishchinta beraza desheva.
Ta chaze, avraham butzina kadmaa kaddisha dealma, kad baa lesalka ledargeh, la yachil, ad desalek vishtemoda beinun telat dargin illain daaleh, dehahu chulaka dileh.

Kevan desalek veishtemoda leh lekudesha berich hu, miggo inun telat dargin, deim inun shiva, deikkeron keter elyon chachma bina, vinun shelimu deeser sefiran, deikre behu kudesha berich hu. vechevan desalek achar kach beinun telata, deinun attika veabba veima, denaged minnehon nehiru letatta, keden achid lechulakeh, hahu darga ditchotayyhu deinun telata, deikre chesed.
Vechalho adbek lon, miggo aspaklarya deshalta belelya, divho mammash la hava bar nash deyada kelum. veal da taninan, ben shelosha shanim, hikkir avraham et boro, ben shelosha dayyka.

Veta chaze, raza dehanne shelosha shenin, vela pachot, begin dishchinta ikre bat sheva, vela yachel leitkerava bahadah, ad desalek beinun telat dargin illain, deim inun 7, leishtemoda miggavvavn, uleitnahara bechol may deihu letatta, veg vez, ha eser dargin illain, raza dishma dekudesha berich hu.

Vechevan dehava mitneher beinun shelosha, baa lesalka beinun sheva, beraza dichtiv, (Bereshit 21:28) vayyatztzev avraham et sheva kivsot hatztzon. veraza da ramez laavimelech, dela yishletun alehon benoy, ad deyishtelimu inun shiva zakkae keshot beyisrael, lokovel inun shiva dargin dilela.
Kevan deyishtelimu, yatev alma tattaa kegavvna dealma illaa. bekiyyuma shelim. vyete david, deihu sheviaa, veyitar lehahi bat sheva dilela, deihi nakma nikmathon deyisrael, veyitpera minnehon.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 8:1) vayhi achare chen vayyach david et pelishtim vayyachniem vayyikkach david et meteg haamma miyyad pelishtim. may vayhi achare chen. batar deishtelimu yisrael, vahavu kegavvna dilela, keden vayyach david et pelishtim vayyachniem. deha ad hasheta la yachilu yisrael
1623: Lemitbar tokfehon, veha itaru chavrayay behahu meteg haamma, veokmuha.

Veta chaze, hay deramaz leh avraham bechivsot hatztzon, velo beizzim, velo bemile acharine, begin deinun missitra dechesed, meinun memannan deyankin missitra dechesed, yankin letatta inun kevasim, techot shuletanehon. vavraham achid lechulakeh middat hachesed, vecholla beraza dechachmeta.

Veal da taninan, man deshare go ana, la mistakken lealmin. vei ihu share go izzayyay, verae lon, kamma gardine nimusin, yatvin lekivleh leastaa leh, begin deinun missitra dedina kashya. aval kad ata yitzchak lemigzar immeh keyaym, gazar immeh beshiva, deitgalleyay miggo hahi bera, dichtiv (Bereshit 26:23) vayyikra otah shiva.

Ta chaze, avraham kara lehahi bera demayyin, beer sheva. yitzchak kara lah, shiva. ma ben hay lehay. ella begin deyitzchak achid lechulakeh darga defachad, deihu dina, veal da osef bah Adonai. vaAdonai bechol atar middat haddin. vesimanach (Yechezkel 16:43) he darkech berosh natatti. hada hu dichtiv vayyikra otah shiva. dela avad bechurefan, kema daavad avuha, vecholla beraza dechachmeta, veosef bah Adonai, leachazaa deihi chulakeh.

Ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, bara leh bedina. kevan dechaza dela mitkayyem, shittef beh chesed. hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit 2:4) behibbaram, beyom asot Adonai elohim, vokmuha beavraham itkayyem alma. begin kach hay bera, beta dealma, al shemeh itkere. hada hu dichtiv, (sham 21) al ken kara lammakom hahu beer shava. af al gav dehay bera itdabbak beyitzchak, dichtiv (sham 26) vayyikra otah shiva. shemah beer shava, sitra deavraham, velo beer shiva, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) vimino techabbekeni.

Veta chaze, 4 meinun shiva zakkae keshot, kad bao leitkerava bishchinta, beraza desheva, kalho iaru behay beer, dela pasku memoy lealmin. avraham kare lah lehay bera, begin deihu olif lechol bene alma, deyiflechun lekudesha berich hu. vechevan dechare lah, appek mayin navin dela paskin lealmin.

Vechevan demet avraham, ma ketiv (Bereshit 26:15) vechol habbeerot asher chafru avde aviv bime avraham. beerot ketiv, vechad hava, dichtiv beer shava, vekaro leh beerot, demashma desaggiin havo. begin dehay bera, mitchaze lon laavahan bechol ducheta dahavo azlin, vahava mitchaze lon keverin saggiin.

Kevan demilleu pelishtim afra, raza deahadderu bene alma laavoda zara, hava alma shamem, delet deyada lekudesha berich hu. kevan deata yitzchak, ma ketiv, vayyashav yitzchak vayyachfor et beerot hammayim asher chafru bime avraham aviv. may vayyashav, ella daatev alma letikkuneh, volef lon livne alma deyedun lekudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv, (sham 25) vayhi achare mot avraham vyvarech elohim et yitzchak beno. vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi, hay bera mimman hu. mimman dechol chayyin illain vetattain vekiyyumehon talyayn beh. vechaze kolla. hada hu dichtiv, (Daniel 2:22) yada ma bachashocha unehora immeh shere.

Veta chaze, inun avde yitzchak begin deinun missitra dedina kashyay, kad chafru lah, ma ketiv, sitna, veha okmuha, ad deata ihu (Bereshit 26:22) vayyachpor beer acheret vegomer, vayyikra shemah rechovot vday. aval avde aviv, begin dechalho atyayn missitra deyamina, la hava sitna bealma, vela nafek dina behay bera, leastana lon, kad la machshere ovadehon.

Umehay bera, ihu pitcha leminda leh lekudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek avo vam ode yah. vead dela salek yitzchak mealma, barich leh leyaakov, ushelacheh lecharan, leizdavga. vechad azel lecharan ma ketiv (Bereshit 29:2) vayyar vehinne beer bassade, kevan dechaza yaakov yekara dekudesha berich hu, miggo hahu bera, deikre beer shava. keden amar leh lelavan, eevadcha sheva shanim berachel bittecha hakketanna dayyka.

Ta chaze, lokovel inun shiva zakkain, paked kudesha berich hu beorayyta, lekarava karban musaf, besheva zimnin beshatta. begin leosafa leho iddunin vetafnukin mibbe malka, deyisbeun avahan bekadmita, uvatar ken benin. veinun 7 zimnin vela yattir.
Beshabbatta lokovel tzaddik yesod olam, deikre chol, veikre shabbat, leosafa leh iddunin mimmocha setimaa, uveresh yarcha, lokoval keneset yisrael, deitkeriat sihara.

Uvetv yoma leyarcha kadmaa, lokovel avraham avuhon, deachid bemiddat hachesed, vikre rishon. uvaatzeret devachodesh hag, deityeyhivat beh orayyta beshiva kolot, lokovel yaakov, deihu telitay laavahan, veachid bekol kol yaakov.

Uverosh hashshana, lokovel yitzchak, deityeled beh, vaanan madkerinan beh akedat yitzchak, veihu yoma dedina, lokovel middat haddin deachid ba. beyom hakkippurim, lokovel moshe, dekabbel kudesha berich hu beh tzeloteh, vechas al yisrael, vahadar leh luche orayyta. bechag hassukkot, lokovel aharon, devizchuteh havo azlin shiva ananin, dechafan al yisrael kesukkot, uvegin kach inun avdin sukka. vechol orayyta, kamma razin illain setimin ba, vechad illen shiva mittosfin bevirchan, kol alma bishlimu saggia.
1624: Vehenif aharon et haleviyyim tenufa lifne Adonai. rabbi yehuda shail lerabbi abba, lama haya hakkohen menif et haleviyyim. amar lo, mashal lema haddavar dome letinok. keshehu boche vechoes, ma osin kede lefayyso. amar leh rabbi yehuda, menifin oto umenaneim oto kede leshatko. amar leh rabbi abba, yehuda yehuda, milla zot baa leyadcha velo chakarta bah, vahalo yishmeu aznecha ma sheppicha medabber.

Kach hi middat haggevura koeset verogezet. dichtiv, (Bereshit 49:5) shimon velevi achim kele chamas mecherotehem. uchetiv (Bereshit 49:7) arur appam ki az veevratam ki kashata. lefi shehem mitgabberim umitkashim beappam veevratam latzet laasot din lechalot ulehachrit bene haolam, azay hakkohen shehu hachesed haelyon menif oto hatzad shel haleviyyim shehi middat haggevura, kede leshakkech uleshaket ragza vechaasa, kede sheyishtabberu hasaarot mikkol shulehen velo yitgabberu velo yitchazku. keen dugema zo, hakkohen shemenif et haleviyyim tenufa kede sheyishkot hatzad shel gevura shelahen kede shello yitorer haddin baolam.

Ba rabbi yehuda venashak et yadav. ukkesheyitorru haddinin baolam, kol haddinim hanimtzaim bechol yom vayom avraham avinu allav hashalom hu doche otam lachutz veenam omdim lefanav, hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim 7) veel zoem bechol yom.

Deinun chad nahar vegan. nahar denafik meeden vegan deishtake minneh. hacha kol raza setima dimhemanuta. volifna, hay man deitar belelya, behahi shaata deal kudesha berich hu bahade tzaddikayyay beginta. itzterich lomar kera da, biruta delibba. ulechavvna dateh beh. uvatar (Tehillim 139:14) odcha al ki noraot nifleti niflaim maasecha venafshi yodaat meod. (ulevatar venahar yotze meeden vegomer) vehayeynu shevacha dechaside kadmae kad mitare befalgut lelya. uvatar mesadre shivchayyhu velaan beorayyta.

Shashua dekudesha berich hu may hu. ella, kol tzaddikayyay dekaymin bediukenayyhu mitlabbeshan beginta bechol yoma veyoma. kevan deitsachan betalla dezamin kudesha berich hu leachayay beh metayyay, alin kulehon legabbe mashiach veshaalin ma deshaalin, veha itaru chavrayyay.

Levatar mitkanneshin umishtadlin kullehu bedata ilaa dechulehu metivte detamman vealayyhu kama memanan. umitchadshe tamman kama chiddushin beorayyta. levatar nafke kullehu vechaman kad ate eliyahu legabbe avahan. ihu nafik veinhu alin vekayyman kame avahan vechaddu behu bechamma benin kaddishin debsacharanayyhu vechaddan kullehu.

Kad ayil kudesha berich hu befalgut lelya kullehu kayyme mitaknan kedka yeot. vechol ishtadluta deishtadle kol hahu yoma bechidushe deorayyta, kudesha berich hu, tiuveteh beinun tzaddikayyay dechadishu bah milin vishtaasha behu vbinun milin.

Levatar kullehu mittaknan dechar venukeba. vekudesha berich hu batar dearaach veishtaasha behu bechol inun milin razin dechachmeta dilhon, itgele alayyhu veinun chaman behahu noam Adonai. keden kullehu chaddan bechedva saggi, ad demitpashshete ziva unehora dilhon. umehahu meshichu ziva unehora dechedva dilhon, avdin perin vibbin lealma da. vehahu peri veibba al techot gadfoy dishchinta, ad zimna deitzterich.

Vechen mishtaashshaa bechol tzaddik vetzaddik (veamar) veamrin, zakkaa ihu malka divnin illen itberiru lechulakeh veadveh. kala itar meemtzaitta dirkia vekara bekal takif vamar, (Tehillim 137:7) zechor Adonai livne edom et yom yerushalayim haomrim aru aru ad hayesod bah. keden artiru dileh vekirkura dileh umikkol tzaddikayyay detamman ishtema bitlat mea vetishin rekiin.

Begin dela it chedva veshashua lekudesha berich hu, ella beshaata dekayyme behu (dekaim bahade) tzaddikayyay detamman. uvegin da ome veamar, (Tehillim 137:5-6) im eshkachech yerushalayim tishkach yemini tidbak leshoni lechikki im lo ezkerechi im lo eele et yerushalayim al rosh simchati. bechol atar deit chedva lekudesha berich hu, kala da nafik vekare.

Keden nafik mittamman vsalik uvatash rekiin veshaig sheigin, ad dechol chele shemaya kullehu beirtura. keden nashva rucha uvatash betarfin dehahu ilana ravreva vechol anpin dileh batshin da beda. vekala itar miggo nofa deilana vekare veamar. (Tehillim 105:8-9) zachar leolam berito davar tzivva leelef dor (divrei hayamim 1 16:15-16) asher karat et avraham ushevuatto leyitzchak. kevan dekala da itar shama avraham sava vitar (keden) kad ihu raava lemalka vitnachem bahadeh.

Behahi shaata itarat rucha chada misitra dedarom vechol reu vechedva vasvavta itar al alma. ucheden salik tzafra veraava ishtekach venayycha lechol asire malka deinun beve marayyhu. zakkaa amma deyachlin leminda merazin temirin setimin demalka kaddisha.
1625: Chad havina ana verabbi yehuda demin akko (azle) bemadbera vealna bimarta chada veashkachna tamman sifra chada attika demin yomin kadmain. patachna leh vashkachna dehava ketiv beh beresh milloy (Yeshayahu 42:9) harishonot hinne bau vechadashot ani maggid. vokim kera benishmatehon detzaddikayyay. min yoma desalik bemachashava lemivre alma.

Vead la itbere alma kol ruchin detzaddikayyay havu genizin bemachashava kameh kol chad vechad bediyyukeneh. kevan detziyyer alma itgalyayn kullehu vekayyimu bediukenayyhu kameh berome meromim. levatar yahav lon beotzar chad beginta deeden leella. vehahu otzar la malya lealmin, vetadir kare harishonot hinne bau vechadashot ani maggid. man inun ani maggid kullehu bishmahan velet tiuveta vechisufa lehay otzar ella learaka beh nishmatin tadir. kema degehinnam let tiuveta vechisufa ella lekabbela nishmatin leitdakkaa tamman vechol yoma kare hav hav. may hav hav (ella) okid okid.

Vehahu otzar natil kol (inun) nishmatin inun ad zimna dealbish lon vnachate lehay alma. umiggo chova deadam kadmaa deamshich sitra bisha lealma itzterichu lealbesha inun nishmatin bilvusha da. deha levusha achara baa kudesha berich hu lealbesha leinun nishmatin. (sefer acher veamar behahu sifra) vehahu (vahava) amar hahu sifra ad hacha shetiku (shetoku). veod chamena mikkan ulehala atvavn mechikan dela ishtemodan.

Uvatar chamena lon bechelma vamru li shetok vela tegale ella letinara takkifa, vechach avidna. vashkachna beh manin dilvusha achara zamin (dezammin) kudesha berich hu lealbesha leinun nishmatin lezimnin (lezimna) deate.

(Im ken) metim dechayu al yeda dichezkel, may tama la avad lon hahu levusha. ella begin dela mata zimna leaabbera bealma hahu avira dachya deavid levushin. uvegin kach albish lon ella kema dahavu, vechach yehe litchiyyayt hammetim, bar dehahu zohama dekadmita la ishtekach tamman.

Kad nafak bar nash mehay alma, kullehu ben tzaddike ben chaside utemime vechayayve verashie. kullehu avre baavira, lemecheme adam kadmaa livne alma. umittamman natil orcha hen leginta deeden hen legehinnam.

Kol inun deorchayyhu leginta deeden, mitkarvin legabbe choma dilvar meinun telat chomot detamman. ucheden nafik chad memanna vitar kammayyhu vekare veamar, zakkain attun tzaddikayyay (bealmin kullehu) bealma. vehahu memanna yazareyal shemeh, olif lon orcha vazlin kameh ad tara chada degehinnam. hahu memune kare becheleh veamar, tzanun tenana (tanenahea) tzanun yakidta. behahi shata, bivhilu metzannin lah vealin kullehu vetavlin veavrin. vechol inun chayyayvin itmasran bida dedvm vealin begehinnam. vechol inun zakkain, la itmasran bidoy. ella (bida) deha memune.

Uvatar detavlin veavrin, hahu memune azil kammayyhu ad dematan leshur deginta deeden vehahu memune kare lefitcha veomer, (Yeshayahu 26:2) pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik shomer emunim. keden patchin fitcha vail lon, vechen bechol fitcha ufitcha.

Kevan dealin lego atar detzaddikayyay, tzaddikayyay ocharanin kayymin vechamma chedva al chedva al tzaddikayyay vechol bene metivta chaddan. lesof telata yomin deittameran behechalin yedian nafke vaavira nashve umittzayyeyran kullehu bediukenayyhu. mikkan ulehala yartin achsanat yeruta kedka chaze lechol chad.

Chazuta deitchaze beginta deeden mechezu yekara diyyukena dechol diukenin vegoon dechol goonin. demalka kaddisha lo itgeli behechala vela beatar chad. ella (itpetach) itpeshach rekia merakma al gabbe ginta learba sitrin veitmalyyay mizziva yakkira kaddisha veitchaze tamman, vithanan kullehu tzaddikayyay. man chama chedva vechissufa dehahu noam Adonai.

Ad kan hava li reshu lemecheme behahu sifra. admakifna lemechome yattir beh, parach min yadi vela chamena leh. ishtaarna atziv uvachena. damichna tamman behahu mearta vechamena leh (lehahu) dehava lavish mana (matza). amar li Rabbi lama lach lemivke vela titatzev (sefer acher mimman) mimma dehava behahu sifra. parach legabbeh venatle vead la yippok mehay alma ganiz leh behahu mearta demadbera da, vehasheta dehava mitgele lechayyay hacha, parach baavira lenatle.

Mikkan ulehala zil lach leorchach, umehahu yoma vead hasheta la itgele li vela zachina lemishma mimman hava. uvechol zimna deana dachirna, ishtaarna atziv. amar ribbi elazar, dilma kudesha berich hu bae vikareh dela bae deyitgalle bealma. ad dahavu yatve velaan bemillin ochoranin illain veyakkirin nahar yemama kamu vazlu. amar rabbi elazar hasheta idan raava mikkame malka kaddisha, nima mile deorayyta venitasek bah vnishtatef bishchinta. patach veamar, (Tehillim Adonai:4) Adonai voker tishma koli voker eroch lecha vaatzappe. (ad kan). amar ribbi elazar, bilam chayyayva, man kattil leh, vehech iktil. amar rabbi yitzchak vechulei.
1626: Lemor hinne am yatza mimitzrayim. i tema deha tzarich lenatla pippusin veyochasin dilhon, la itzterich ella orach kelal dichtiv hinne am yatza. may tama, mishum dehachi kare lon patrona dilhon kama zimmenin. veal da la tite dichtiv (Shemot Adonai:1) shalach et ami bechol zeman.

Veod kad natlat eta alayyhu im paro belishna da yachalt lehu. dichtiv, (Shemot 1:9) hinne am bene yisrael rav veatzum mimmennu. uf hasheta dichtiv, hinne am yatza momitzrayim vela appik lon achara, ella ihu miggarmeh nafak. uvegin kach techul leavasha lon.

Hinne kisa et en haaretz, it deamre sichon veog dekatle (dekatlu) lon yisrael, dahavu ena deara. ella kad ayyte kudesha berich hu arbe al ara demitzrayim. ketiv, (Shemot 10:15) vaychas et en kol haaretz vatechshach haaretz. amay, begin dechol charshin vekismin dealma la yachlin lemebad charshin ella milla chada bedarga chada, bezimna chada. veamma da ayyte arov mebbulebal mikkamma zinin mebbulebalin illen beillen, ad dela yachlu kol charshin vekismin lemekam. veda hu vaychas et en kol haaretz. vehacha ketiv, vaychas et en haaretz vehachi hu vadday.

Amar Rabbi abba balak vbilam la hava bealma charshin vekismin kevavtayyhu (bilam) cheleh vetukefeh hava befumeh veeneh. balak cheleh vetukefeh hava beovada deyyadin. veda itzterich leda, deha kol zine charshin dealma befuma veovada hu, uvehu talyayn. bilam hava leh lishan vela yedin, balak hava leh yedin vela lishan.

Azlu chavrayyay ad dematu chad be chakal veshimsha hava takif lachada. chamu hahu be chakal beshappiru deisbin umayin nafkin lechol setar veilane chakla saggiin, yatvu tamman. amar rabbi elazar, kama yeot atar da lenayycha beh.

Adhavo yatve, ha chivya ravreva ata vetukefa deshimsha veaavar kammayyhu. amar leh ribbi elazar, chivya chivya, sate lach meorchach, deha tav hahu gavra vitnachem al ma deavad, vela yosif lemebad hahu milla. tavvhu chavrayyay. amar Rabbi abba may hu. amar lon shetoku. amar ribbi elazar, chivya chivya, levatar delachishu lach min shemaya, itnecham hahu gavra veshavvi biruteh dela yetiv beh lealmin sate lach meorchach. kam chivya bekiumeh vela natil hacha vehacha. tav kemilkadmin. amar leh, chivya chivya, yadana ma deat bae, tuv mearchach. deha goy chayyayva ate, deavid bish lechad yuday. veha hu naim shachiv bimarta dilach, zil vekatleh. miyad ahdar hahu chivya vedilleg diluggin kammayyhu.

Amar rabbi elazar, i la havina hacha, kama bishin hava avid hay chivya. deha kad bar nash yuday avad ovada dechova, vead la tav betiuveta, lechishu leh lehay chivya lekatla leh. veimlach hahu bar nash ben kach uven kach, veitnachem mechoveh. veamar dela yetuv lealmin lehay chattaa veal da ishteziv min dina.

Amru chavrayyay lerabbi elazar, bema yadat. amar lehu, simana yahav li abba, vaana ishtemodana beh. amru leh, tinach chivya deishtemodat beh. hahu deitnecham vetav mechoveh bema yadat. amar lehu, kad hava azil hahu chivya, kaskassoy havu salkin vzanvoy zakif veihu deazil (azil) bivhilu. rucha chada hava azil lokovle vehava kare kameh, tuv mearchach. deha tav mechoveh veitnechem hahu bar nash. vehahu chivya bisha la hava tzayyit ad deyitnun leh kofer bahadeh beatreh dehahu bar nash deitchayyayv katola vetav. dechach orchoy dechivya ela vetatta, kevan deityeyhiv leh reshu, la tav ad deashlim hahu dina bisha deityeyhiv leh reshu lemebad, o deyitnun leh beatreh chayyayva achara bekofra. deha berekanayyay la yippok. kevan deityeyhiv leh reshu.

Amru leh, tinach kol da. hahu goy deamarat dihavt leh kofra, bemay yadat. amar lon, kevan demallelit lechivya, hahu rucha dehava azil lokovle velachish leh dituv leorcheh deha itnecham hahu bar nash. dalig hahu rucha al udeneh. (udene veamar li).

Tavvhu chavrayyay. amar rabbi elazar, nehach venechme, deha chivya avad ma deavad. kamu vekarivu gabbe chad tinara behahu be chakal, ashkachu lehahu goy demit vehahu nachash karich al ikveh vela hava avdil minneh, uvatar itperash meakveh vesalik al geroneh veachrich tamman. umittamman nachit al akaveh, dela hava mitperash minneh.
Ashkachu leh arnaki chad malya dinarin degazil lechad yuday bearcha umecha leh. natal rabbi elazar yat arnaki. amar, berich rachamana debchola avid shelichuta. tavu lehahu atar dahavu (1 7 30 10).

Patach rabbi elazar veamar, (Yeshayahu 43:4) measher yakarta beenay nichbadta vaani ahavticha vaetten adam tachtecha uleummim tachat nafshecha. measher yakarta, yakar mibbae leh, vehachi itzterich. measher atta yakar beenay, mahu yakarta. mikkelal deihu miggarmeh ityaykar. ella hachi hu vadday, dechol bar nash deihu bechiuva
1627: Kame kudesha berich hu bekadmita, hu mezalzela vetoeva (toevta) kame kudesha berich hu. uvatar deimlach vetav mechoveh, hasheta ihu ityaykar miggarmeh. vekudesha berich hu kare aleh vamar, measher yakarta beenay nichbadta, at migarmach yakarta.

Beenay nichbadta vaani ahavticha. deha let rechimu lekudesha berich hu bahade bar nash behay alma, ella beman detav mechoveh. veal da ani ahavticha. aval ma aavid deha yahavit reshu lechivya lenazka. da hu eta, vaetten adam tachtecha. may ihu adam dihav kudesha berich hu techoteh, hahu adam deate meamma achara, dehahu chivya middileh yechul, dichtiv vaetten adam. al tikre adam, ella edom. uleummim da hu, leom milom yeematz, veda zara deesav deyahiv techot nafsheh.

Adhavo yatve, ha hay yuday degazal hahu goy dekatal chivya, ata beorcha lae veayef. umiggo takkifu deshimsha al behahu chakal veyativ techot ilana chad, vehava mitraem lekudesha berich hu, umatzdik aleh dina, veamar. mareh dealma, galuy vyadua kammach deana la chayyishna alay veal gufi veal mamoni kelum, deha bedina itavid kol (45) deitavid. aval abba veima savin it li delet li bemma afarnes lon, veal da chayyishna.
Vetu al kol da, tzerora chada dedinarin dehava behahu arnaki dechad miskena lemebad chuppa livratteh anyay. ma aavid mare dealma, al da kaivna belibbay yattir.

Bacha veamar (tehillim 119) mishpate Adonai emet tzadku yachdav. dinin demare alma, keshot inun. amay inun keshot, begin detzadku yachdav. deha beshaata dedina dekudesha berich hu bae lemebad (dina), kama mare terisin kayymin mehay setar umehay setar umatzdikin illen beillen umaggichin illen beillen. kevan detzadku illen beillen vistakkeman kachada, keden mishpate Adonai emet. ematay tzadku yachdav. kad matzdike kol bene dina leela. veal da mare dealma, al da bachena velo al didi.

Shama Rabbi elazar vechavrayyay vekamu legabbeh. chamu yateh dehava yativ techot hahu ilana veatkifu beh unetalu yateh legabbehon. amar rabbi elazar, (lo tidchal) zakkaa keshot, dei lav zakkaa ant, la yarchish lach kudesha berich hu nisa ravreva kema deavad. bekadmita tol arnaki dilach vetezil vetechme ma deavid kudesha berich hu beginach. azal bahadayyhu vechama hahu goy mit vechivya hava avid beh nukemin vehava kerich al kadle. ishtattach hahu yuday beafra vode veshabbach lemare alma. vekam vnashik yedoy deribbi elazar vechavrayyay. amar lon hasheta yadana dekudesha berich hu archish nisa da beginayychu.
Aval rabbanan, al abba veima savin deit li bachena veal miskena deyahiv li tzerora. patach haarnaki veachme lon tzerora vechen achme lon macha deavad leh hahu goy. tzalle rabbi elazar aleh veittese.

Kerivu legabbeh dehahu goy kemilkadmin, vechamu hahu chivya dehava avid kedbekadmita. amar rabbi elazar, chivya kol ma deavadt yeot avadt. vetu deachmit chelach ugevuretach beh, veavdat beh nukemin saggiin. veha chamenan telat zimnin vachmit kol ma deavadt. mikkan ulehala zil vittamar bimartach, vegazarna alach dela tanzik leviryayta dealma. itperash hahu chivya vechafaf resheh veazal leh.

Amar rabbi elazar lehahu yuday, tol adaa desanach. deha kisa dedahava it leh legabbeh deshavak leh bereh dehahu goy leavoy, vela titol middileh kelum. vezil legabbeh gavra deduch pelan, vetishkach demita itteh. zil legabbeh vehav leh kisa dedinarin da, begin dehahu gavra it leh bera chad vshimon shemeh vehu azil bischorata al yamma. vinun bearba, bereh dehay goy ganav leh hay kisa, veyahav leh lehahu rasha. veema lehahu yuday deyaslik kisa da livreh, delaaggal yete legabbeh, vyode lekudesha berich hu deachzar avedata lemareh. vechach avid, natal kisa vesagid kameh deribbi elazar venashik yedoy, tavvhu chavrayyay.

Amar rabbi abba, bechol orcha da ihu tavvha bechol ma dechaminan bach. vehasheta ihu tavvha al tavvha, mahu den. amar lehu, milla da, lav besimana ihi, velav bechachmata. ella rucha dili istachal vaana chamena keilu beena chamena. tavvhu kullehu chavrayyay, azlu kullehu chavrayyay vehahu yuday bahadayyhu. ad dematu legabbeh chamoy. kevan dematu letamman, ashkechuhu lechamoy dehava yativ al gabbe arsoy velae beorayyta. barich birchata rabbi elazar, uverichu chavrayyay vihu chadde bahadayyhu:

Patach rabbi elazar vamar, (Yirmeyahu 17:14) refaeni Adonai verafe hoshieni veivashea. kevan deamar refaeni Adonai, mahu verafe. kevan deamar hoshieni, mahu vivashea. kevan deasya mase, man hu demache.
Ella (nusach acher amar rabbi yose chamuy), kol asvavta dealma bida dekudesha berich hu, aval it minhon al yeda dishlicha vit minhon dela itmesaru bida dishlicha. veinun deitmasru bida
1628: Dishlicha asvavta inun, aval lezimnin mithadran. aval inun dekudesha berich hu mase, la mithadran lealmin, veal da asvavta dileh ihi asvavta delet bah mara kelal. uvegin kach, refaeni Adonai veerafe, veda bela kitruga kelal. vehasheta chavrayya, kudesha berich hu yahav li asvavta veashak li vearav li.
Sachu leh kol hahu ovada tavav uvacha vechadde. amar, chavrayyay nadarna deehach legabbeh vitchabbar bahadeh, vnode uneshabbach lemare alma. chadde bahadayyhu.

Amru leh, bemay havita mitassek. amar lon befarashat balak havina mitassek vechamena dechachmeta dileh, hava takkif veyattir mechachmata debilam. chachmata debilam riga chada, chachmata debalak bechol zimna. aval maftechan kullehu bidoy debilam havi, deihu hava shelim befuma. balak hava yada lemebad charshoy, vela hava yada leashlama befuma.
Patach veamar, (Yirmeyahu 30:10) vatta al tira avdi yaakov vegomer. hay kera (it leistakkela beh) ukemuha. aval al tira avdi yaakov mecharshoy debilam veal techat mikasmoy debalak.

Ta chaze, hech havu tarvayyhu da beda beeta bisha lekobbel yisrael. amar bilam, yaakov beveta delavan abba hava, venachash nachshin lokobbeleh, veyachil leh. ana asader nachshin lokobbeleh. amar balak, vaana asader kismin lishma deikkere yisrael.

Behahi shaata nafak rucha chada misitra deyosef miggo anfe ilana vnashiv beinun nechashim uvatil lon. vehayeynu deamar yosef (Bereshit 44:15) ki nachesh yenachesh ish asher kamoni. may ish asher kamoni, begini it ish denchashim yevatel lebnayychu, begini ihu leella. vehayeynu ish asher kamoni. it ish leella denafak rucha achara miggo ilana diltatta vnashiv behahu kesem uvatil lon.
Vehayeynu kesem al sifte melech. man melech da, ilana diltatta. keden attiv bilam vamar, ki lo nachash beyaakov velo kesem beyisrael, vetarvayhu havu bitren sitrin illen.

Ki ittecha ani, la havu yomin min yoma deitbere alma deitzterich hachi lemehevi kudesha berich hu bahadayyhu deyisrael, kehahu zimna devaa bilam leshetzaa lesanehon deyisrael mealma. veal da amar kudesha berich hu, bilam baa leshetzaa lechu mealma, aval ana la aavid hachi. (Yirmeyahu 30:11) ki eese kalla bechol haggoyim asher hiddachticha shamma veotcha lo eese challa. deillu yetun kol bene alma, la yechlun leshetzaa lechon mealma.

Ata lavan bekadmita uvea leakara leh leyaakov bilchodoy mealma, ata kudesha berich hu vaaggin aleh. dichtiv (Bereshit 33) hishamer lecha pen tedabber im yaakov mittov ad ra. ata paro uvaa leshetzaa lon mealma, ata kudesha berich hu vaaggin alayyhu dichtiv, (Shemot 1:12) vechaasher yeanu oto ken yirbe vechen yifrotz. ata haman uvea leshetzaa lon, ata kudesha berich hu vaggin alayyhu vaattiv kolla al resheh. vechen bechol dara vedara kudesha berich hu aggin alayyhu deyisrael tadir.

Veyisrael amre (Eicha 3:22) chasde Adonai ki lo tamnu ki lo challu rachamav. ki lo tamu mibbae leh, ella chasde Adonai bechol dara vedara havu besaadan, ki lo tamnu vela ishtatzena. may tama, dela itmenau rachmoy minan, dichtiv ki lo challu rachamav.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv bekadmita, vayishlach malachim el bilam ben beor. ulevatar ketiv, vayyelchu zikne moav vezikne midyan. hava leh lememar vayyavou hammalachim, may tama deka shane milla mimmay dekaamar bekadmita.
Ella hahu rasha debalak chakkim hava bechol dargin dilella inun dekashrin kishrin lemebad behu charshin vekismin, vechol inun dargin ilain (minnayyhu) milayyhu, dibbehu kafyayn ledargin tattain.
Amar leh, bechol zimna daanan charshin vekasmin venachshin it lan dargin yedian umalachin yedian deishtemodan legabbe charshin vekasmin. aval mikkan ulehala it lach leayyna beatar achara ilaa.

Katav leh shemahan acharanin beinun dargin kaddishin, vehachi orchayyhu dekasmin vecharshin, yade inun dargin dehahu kesem sharyay alayyhu. veavdin charshayyhu veuman lon bedargin acharanin illain minayyhu, veavdin ma deavdin.
Shalach leh hachi, amma da, lav kishra dilhon kishar ammin dealma, aval kishra dilhon baatar achara ilaa mitkashran leella mikkol dargin.

Katav veshallach leh pippusa ufatrona ditresar neshivin (nasheyan) desacharan galgale reticha dechuresayyay kaddisha. amar leh, i tistakkel, behane tistakkel. begin dehane teresar demitkashran beyv shivtin. vei behane tabed charshin, voddiyyukena dilhon letatta deinun 12 shivtin veyv diglin perishin, nechul lehu vnagich behu kerava veneekar lehu mealma.

Vehayeynu vayshallach malachim. vday hada hu dichtiv, ukesamim beyadam. pippusin demalachin kaddishin havu atyayn bidayyhu. veihu la yada dechol dargin illain bida dekudesha berich hu inun. ma chashiv balak, chashiv deama deyisrael itmesaru lemalachin kishar ammin dealma. veal da katav shemahan deillen malachin teresar, veshallach leh. vehayeynu vayishllach malachim.
Amar leh, ta chaze, kol dargin deinun mitkashran kishrin
1629: Letavra amma da, misitra detzafon inun. umisitra detzafon zeminin leminpal veshuletanu decharshin dilan besitra detzafon inun. hasheta nechul leaggacha behon kerava deha teresar illen (deinnun) mitkashran behu, umisitra detzafon sharyayn lemimne.

Vehoil umismola sharyayn tukefa dilhon, itchalash vittebar. begin dechol tukefa dilhon lehahu setar ihu. mahu dekaamar dichtiv (divrei hayamim 2 4:4) omed al shenem asar bakar shelosha ponim tzafona, mitztzafon share lemimne. amar ha tukefa dilan mitztzafon ihu veinun arbaim chaser chad, dargin takkifin mipparzela unechasha uttechotayyhu let lon chushebana. veal da nechul leaggacha kerava uleitgaraa behu.

Vekudesha berich hu la avid hachi, dela shavik lon lemalachim vela lechele shemaya. ella lekudesha berich hu bilchodoy. vechol malachin ravrevin veshiltonin, pelag al kol shear ammin. vechad atu yisrael, natil lon ihu bilchodoy veachasin lon vetukefa begufa deilana vela shavak lon bida demalachin, vela bida dimmannan veravrevin dealma. dichtiv (Devarim 32:8) behanechel elyon goyim vegomer. villen 12 techumin metachman bed sitre alma. levatar devadar anpin vetarfin, natal leyisrael vachasin lon vetukefa degufa deilana. dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.

Amar rabbi elazar, kammah yeot veshappir hay. zakkaa orcha dilan. vechamma milin illain kaddishin ravvavchna lon vechamena. hahu yuday hava tamman lekamayyhu. amar lon, rabbanan, kol milin illen, kama tavan. umilin illain kaddishin ninhu. may dichtiv batreh, yimtzaehu beeretz midbar uvetohu yelel yeshimon vegomer.

Amru leh, i yadat beh milla, ema. deha ukemu beavraham, deashkach leh kudesha berich hu beara defalche avoda zara vela havu yade bimhemnuta dekudesha berich hu. ella kullehu havu taan batar avoda zara, vekam avraham ufarach benayyhu anafa chada shelim, kodam mare dealma. vashkach leh tamman.

Ma avad kudesha berich hu, natal leh lehahu anfa, veaakar leh mittamman vashre leh, vishtaddel. veshatal leh beara achara. dichtiv (Bereshit 12) lech lecha meartzecha vegomer. veavid minneh amma kaddisha. veda hi metzia deashkach kudesha berich hu bealma beara, dela mehemne beh vekudesha berich hu vela yade man ihu.

Amar hahu yuday shappir hu, veyeot milla da. aval it leshaala, i avraham hava diyyukena deitzterich. vetu deha kera, la ochach al avraham kelal vela idkar leavraham kelal, vela leyitzchak, ella leyaakov bilchodoy. dichtiv ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov vegomer, uvatreh ketiv, yimtzaehu vegomer.

Amar rabbi elazar, im kol ze lo kashya hacha. deha avraham ashkechan denafak miggo palche avoda zara. vehacha af al gav deyaakov adkar, hu al avraham. velet pirucha kelal bemilla da. aval i yadat milla o chiddosha ima:

Patach veamar hahu yuday (Bereshit 1:2) vehaaretz hayta tohu vavohu vegomer. man aretz, hahi deishtemoda ilaa vetattaa. hayta tohu, may tohu. da kav yarok deakif kol alma vikre kav tohu. dichtiv (yeshaya 31) vnata aleh kav tohu vavne bohu. bohu, kema detanenan, avanin mefulamot demishtakan go tehome uminhon nafke mayin.

Hasheta it leminda. tohu deihu kav yarok, man hava (hu) kav yarok, ella ashkechan besifra deasya dekartinaa veyodan dekesare shemeh, vekaran shemeh asya kartinaa. begin dehu rav al kol asyayn veyakkira bechachmata. vehachi amar (imre) belashon parsi lebar nash yakkira. vehu amar, vehaaretz hayta tohu, may tohu, ihi kav yarok deaschar alma. uman ihu kelippa deegoza veda ihu kelippa dilvar deihu yarok.

Lego minneh bohu, veinun avanin mefulamot deminnehon nafke mayin. min tohu itmashchan or uvasar. min bohu itmeshachu garme lego minneh. vechoshech, da meshichu deitmeshach minneh amma deesav. vei tema man tohu. hare (hachi) hu vday, deha choshech minneh talyyay. ella inun avanin mefulamot, alu beemtzaita deminneh itmashchan garme kema deittemar. vechoshech meshichu dakik, deminneh itmeshach esav.

Veruach elohim da mocha deegoza, demittamman itmeshach yaakov shelema, kegavvna deegoza da. raza dichtiv (Yechezkel 1:4) vehinne ruach seara baa min hatztzafon, lokovleh detohu. lego minneh, anan gadol, lekobbeleh debohu. lego minneh, veesh mitlakkachat, lekobbeleh dechoshech. lego minneh, vnoga lo saviv, lekobbeleh deruach elohim.

Umitocha keen hachashmal, lego mikkolla. lekobbeleh merachefet al pene hammayim. da rucha deima ilaa, deka merachefet al kolla. veyaakov shelema ihu, veda mocha deegoza vekudesha berich hu yimtzaehu beeretz midbar, vday. levatar avad kudesha berich hu dechol inun kelippin yehon kulehon mishtabedan leh.

Ad hacha hava ketiv behahu sifra (deasya) dekartinaa asya. levatar hava rashim behay kera, kol netura deitzterich asya, chakkim lemebad lemera deshachiv beve mare asire demalka, lemiflach lemare alma.
Dechad azil asya chakkim legabbeh, yimtzaehu beeretz midbar uvetohu yelel yeshimon. marin desharyayn aleh ashkach leh
1630: Baasire demalka. i tema hoil vekudesha berich hu yifkod letafsha leh dela yishtaddal bar nash abbatreh, lav hachi. deha david amar (Tehillim 41:2) ashre maskil el dal vegomer vedal hu deshachiv beve mare. vei asya chakkim hu, kudesha berich hu yahav leh birchaan lehahu deyishtaddal beh.

Vehahu asya yimtzaehu beeretz midbar, beve mare shachiv. uvetohu yelel yeshimon, deinun marin dachakin leh. may itzterich leh lemebad yesovevenhu, yesovev sibbuv veyete ilot begin deyimna minneh inun millin denazkin leh, yakiz leh, veyippuk minneh dama bisha. yevonnehu, yistakkel veyavin, hahu mara mimma havi. veyistakkel begin dela yitrabbe aloy veyimach leh. levatar yitzrenhu keishon eno, begin diyhe natir kedka yeot beinun mashkin, beinun asvavta deitzterichu leh. vela yite minayyhu, deilmale yite afillu bemilla chada, kudesha berich hu chashiv al asya keilu shafich dama vekatleh.

Begin dekudesha berich hu bae deaf al gav dehahu bar nash ihu be asire demalka, deyishtaddal bar nash aleh viysayyea leh leappaka leh mibbe asire. vehava amar hachi, kudesha berich hu dan dini bene alma leella, hen lamut, hen lesharushe, hen laakor, hen laanosh nichsin. man deitchaze laanosh nichsin, nafil beve mare vela yitse, ad deavar kol ma deitgazar aleh. kevan deitanash bemamoneh, veyahiv leh kol ma deitgazar aleh, itse venafak mibbe asire. veal da itzterich leishtaddela aleh, deyitten onasha veyippuk.

Man deitchaze lesharushe, yittefsun leh, veyahave leh beve asire. ad deyishtaresh mikkola. ulezimnin deyishtaresh mishayyfoy, o mechad minayyhu, ulevatar yippekun leh mibbe asire. man deitchaze lamut, hachi hu, deillu yitten kol kofra vechol mamona dealma la yishteziv.

Veal da itzterich leasyyay chakkim leishtaddela aleh, i yachil lemehav leh asvavta min gufa, yeot. vei lav, yitten leh asvata lenishmateh vyishtedal al asvavta denishmata. veda hu asya dekudesha berich hu yishtaddal aleh behay alma uvealma deate.

Amar rabbi elazar, ad hasheta la shamana measyyay da umisifra da, bar mozimna chada. deamar li tayyaya chada deshama leavoy, deasya chad hava veyomoy. dechad hava mistakkel bevar nash kad ihu beve mare, hava amar, da chay veda mit. vahavu amrin aleh, (dehu hava zakkaa), dachil chattaa. vechol man dela yachil lemidbak 124 lemizban] ma deitzterich, ihu hava kane leh veyahiv moddileh. vahavu amrin, delet chakkim bealma kegine. uvitzloteh hava avid yattir mimma dehava avid bidoy, vechaddome lan, da hava hahu asya.

Amar hahu tayyaya, vadday sifra dileh beyadi ihu, deka yeritna meavi abba. vechol milloy dehahu sifra, kullehu ityyaysdan al razin deorayyta verazin setimin ashkachna beh. umilin deasvavta deihu amar dela yeot lemifal lon, bar man deihu dachil chattaa.

Veinun mimma dehava avid bilam dehava lachish al mera, vehu amar befumeh, veittese miyad. vechullehu barir lon behahu sifra. veamar, da asur veda muttar leman dedachil chattaa, begin demarin saggiin amar, detalyay asvavta dilhon bilchishu depuma, vinun misitra denachash, uminhon misitra dekesem. vechol inun deasur lomar befuma veasur lemebad veovada, hava amar. ad deashkachna al marin yedian deitzterich lomar kach, ulenaduye beniduy uveshamatta al hahu mera, veihu tavvha saggi legabban.

Chadde rabbi elazar vechaddu chavrayyay. amar ribbi elazar i hay sifra hava legabban, nechme may ihu. amar, ana emsar bimsira al menat leachavaa (leachazaa) levotzina kaddisha. vetanenan, amar ribbi elazar, hahu sifra hava bidi teresar yarche, vashkachna beh nehorin illain. kad matena leinun razin dahavu mibbilam tavavhna.

Yoma chad lachishna beatar chad, vahavu atvavn salkan vnachtan. ad dechaminan bechelma veamar li, ma lach lemeal bitchuma delav dilach. ittearna veavish kammay al razin setimin dahavu tamman, shadarna lehahu yuday veyahivna leh sifra.

Ubberazin debilam ashkachna meinun shemahan demalachim deshadar leh balak, vela havu mitsadran al tikunayyhu. aval kama zine asvavta ashkachna beh deka mittakne al tikkune orayyta verazin setimin dileh. vechamena deinun bechasiduta utzelotin lekudesha berich hu. vei tema dehava avid asvavta bippesuke deorayyta, chas veshalom. ella hava amar razin deorayyta, veal hahu raza appik razin deasvavta, dela chamena kehahu goona lealmin. amena, berich rachamana deachkim livne nasha bechachmata dilella.

Umeynun millin debilam nasivna. vechamena behu, dela hava bealma chakkim becharshin kegineh. amena, berich rachamana devatil mealma charshin dela yitun bene nasha mibbatar dachalta dekudesha berich hu. ad kan:
1631: (Bereshit 28:12) vayyachalom vehinne sulam, da tzelota. mutztzav artza, dimtzallin bene nasha lah beara deihi shechinta umatat lishmayya deihu kudesha berich hu, deittemar (Melachim 1 8:32) veatta tishma hashshamayim. veraza demila (Tehillim 8:10) Adonai adonenu ma addir shemach bechol haaretz asher hodcha al hashshamayim.

Ubbezimna demoda lon kudesha berich hu, shechinta desalka behahi tzelota. miyyad (Bereshit 28:12) vehinne malache elohim olim veyordim bo, behahu bar nash. kullehu patchin gadfayyhu lekobbel shechinta (behahi) behahu tzelota. hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:11) ufenehem vechanfehem perudot milmala. vehay ihu olim shechinta al gadfayyhu.

Veyordim bo, may bo, vekudesha berich hu. vekudesha berich hu nachit alayyhu lekabbela shechinta, umityyayched kudesha berich hu bo (behahi) behahu tzelota. dishchinta ihi mitzva kelila mishem havayya, Adonai ihi chayya dileh, umitzva bela machashava let lah seliku. umachashava ihu adam yod hei vav hei, tiferet
